//! vit bindings. GENERATED by `vit dev genrust` (run by `make build` in ../vit):
//! do not edit.
//!
//! Each method runs `vit --json -v <args>` as a subprocess, with an argv list
//! (never a shell), and blocks until the command ends: call it from a worker thread.

#![allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]

use std::io::{BufRead, BufReader, Read};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::{Command, Stdio};
use std::sync::mpsc;

use serde::de::DeserializeOwned;
use serde::{Deserialize, Deserializer};

// ---- errors ----------------------------------------------------------------

#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum Error {
    /// The command refused the operation: `name` is vit's error code.
    Standard {
        command: String,
        name: String,
        message: Vec<String>,
        extra: Vec<serde_json::Value>,
    },
    /// vit failed unexpectedly.
    Internal {
        command: String,
        name: String,
        message: Vec<String>,
        raw_err: String,
    },
    /// vit could not be run, or died without reporting an error.
    Io {
        command: String,
        source: std::io::Error,
    },
    /// vit's output is not what these bindings expect.
    Parse { command: String, detail: String },
    /// An argument that vit would read as a flag (it starts with `-`).
    InvalidArgument { argument: String },
}

impl std::fmt::Display for Error {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::Standard { command, name, message, .. } => {
                write!(f, "vit {command}: {} [{name}]", message.join(" "))
            }
            Self::Internal { command, name, message, raw_err } => {
                write!(f, "vit {command}: internal error {name}: {} {raw_err}", message.join(" "))
            }
            Self::Io { command, source } => write!(f, "vit {command}: {source}"),
            Self::Parse { command, detail } => write!(f, "vit {command}: bad output: {detail}"),
            Self::InvalidArgument { argument } => {
                write!(f, "argument '{argument}' can't start with '-'")
            }
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for Error {
    fn source(&self) -> Option<&(dyn std::error::Error + 'static)> {
        match self {
            Self::Io { source, .. } => Some(source),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
}

// ---- events ----------------------------------------------------------------

/// What a command reports while it runs.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum Event {
    ProgressStart(ProgressManifest),
    ProgressItem(ProgressItem),
    ProgressEnd(ProgressFinish),
    /// `level` is empty for a line that is not a structured log.
    Log { level: String, message: String, attrs: serde_json::Value },
}

/// For callers that don't need progress nor logs.
pub fn no_events(_: Event) {}

// ---- results ---------------------------------------------------------------

// Go writes a nil slice or map as `null`: read it, or a missing field, as empty.
fn null_default<'de, D, T>(d: D) -> Result<T, D::Error>
where
    D: Deserializer<'de>,
    T: Default + Deserialize<'de>,
{
    Ok(Option::<T>::deserialize(d)?.unwrap_or_default())
}
<% range .Structs %>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq, Deserialize)]
pub struct <% .Name %> {<% range .Fields %>
    #[serde(rename = "<% .JSONName %>", default, deserialize_with = "null_default")]
    pub <% .Name %>: <% .Type %>,<% end %>
}
<% end %>
// ---- flags -----------------------------------------------------------------
<% range .Methods %><% if .OptsType %>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct <% .OptsType %> {<% range .Flags %>
    /// <% .Doc %>
    pub <% .Name %>: <% if eq .Kind "bool" %>bool<% else if eq .Kind "str" %>Option<String><% else %>Option<Vec<String>><% end %>,<% end %>
}
<% end %><% end %>
// ---- client ----------------------------------------------------------------

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Client {
    binary: PathBuf,
    dir: Option<PathBuf>,
}

impl Client {
    /// `binary` is the vit executable: a path, or a name looked up on PATH.
    pub fn new(binary: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> Self {
        Self { binary: binary.into(), dir: None }
    }

    /// Runs the commands from `dir`, the way a repo-relative path expects.
    pub fn in_dir(mut self, dir: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Self {
        self.dir = Some(dir.as_ref().to_owned());
        self
    }
<% range .Methods %>
    /// <% .Description %>
    pub fn <% .Name %>(
        &self,<% range .Positionals %>
        <% .Name %>: &str,<% end %><% range .Optionals %>
        <% .Name %>: Option<&str>,<% end %><% if .Variadic %>
        <% .Variadic.Name %>: &[&str],<% end %><% if .OptsType %>
        opts: &<% .OptsType %>,<% end %>
        on_event: &mut dyn FnMut(Event),
    ) -> Result<<% .ResultType %>, Error> {
        #[allow(unused_mut)]
        let mut args: Vec<String> = vec![<% range .CmdParts %>"<% . %>".to_owned(), <% end %>];<% range .Positionals %>
        args.push(positional(<% .Name %>)?);<% end %><% range .Optionals %>
        if let Some(value) = <% .Name %> {
            args.push(positional(value)?);
        }<% end %><% if .Variadic %>
        for value in <% .Variadic.Name %> {
            args.push(positional(value)?);
        }<% end %><% range .Flags %><% if eq .Kind "bool" %>
        if opts.<% .Name %> {
            args.push("-<% .FlagName %>".to_owned());
        }<% else if eq .Kind "str" %>
        if let Some(value) = &opts.<% .Name %> {
            args.push(format!("-<% .FlagName %>={value}"));
        }<% else %>
        if let Some(values) = &opts.<% .Name %> {
            args.push(format!("-<% .FlagName %>={}", values.join(",")));
        }<% end %><% end %>
        self.run(args, on_event)
    }
<% end %>
    fn run<T: DeserializeOwned>(
        &self,
        args: Vec<String>,
        on_event: &mut dyn FnMut(Event),
    ) -> Result<T, Error> {
        let command = args.join(" ");
        let io_error = |source| Error::Io { command: command.clone(), source };

        let mut cmd = Command::new(&self.binary);
        cmd.args(["--json", "-v"])
            .args(&args)
            .stdin(Stdio::null())
            .stdout(Stdio::piped())
            .stderr(Stdio::piped());
        if let Some(dir) = &self.dir {
            cmd.current_dir(dir);
        }
        let mut child = cmd.spawn().map_err(io_error)?;

        // Both pipes are read at once: a full one would block vit.
        let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel();
        if let Some(stdout) = child.stdout.take() {
            forward_lines(stdout, Line::Out, tx.clone());
        }
        if let Some(stderr) = child.stderr.take() {
            forward_lines(stderr, Line::Err, tx);
        } else {
            drop(tx);
        }

        let mut result = None;
        let mut failure = None;
        let mut last_stderr = String::new();
        for line in rx {
            match line {
                Line::Out(line) => {
                    // Anything else on stdout is not part of the protocol.
                    let Ok(message) = serde_json::from_str::<Message>(&line) else { continue };
                    match message.kind.as_str() {
                        "output" => result = message.result,
                        "error" => failure = message.error,
                        "progress" => {
                            if let Some(event) = message.progress.and_then(ProgressMessage::event) {
                                on_event(event);
                            }
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                }
                Line::Err(line) => {
                    on_event(log_event(&line));
                    last_stderr = line;
                }
            }
        }
        let status = child.wait().map_err(io_error)?;

        if let Some(failure) = failure {
            return Err(failure.into_error(command));
        }
        if !status.success() {
            let detail = format!("exited with {status}: {last_stderr}");
            return Err(io_error(std::io::Error::other(detail)));
        }
        let Some(result) = result else {
            return Err(Error::Parse { command, detail: "no result".to_owned() });
        };
        serde_json::from_value(result).map_err(|e| Error::Parse { command, detail: e.to_string() })
    }
}

// vit reads anything starting with '-' as a flag, wherever it is.
fn positional(value: &str) -> Result<String, Error> {
    if value.starts_with('-') {
        return Err(Error::InvalidArgument { argument: value.to_owned() });
    }
    Ok(value.to_owned())
}

enum Line {
    Out(String),
    Err(String),
}

fn forward_lines(
    pipe: impl Read + Send + 'static,
    wrap: fn(String) -> Line,
    tx: mpsc::Sender<Line>,
) {
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        for line in BufReader::new(pipe).lines() {
            let Ok(line) = line else { break };
            if !line.is_empty() && tx.send(wrap(line)).is_err() {
                break;
            }
        }
    });
}

fn log_event(line: &str) -> Event {
    let Ok(serde_json::Value::Object(mut log)) = serde_json::from_str(line) else {
        return Event::Log {
            level: String::new(),
            message: line.to_owned(),
            attrs: serde_json::Value::Null,
        };
    };
    let mut text = |key: &str| match log.remove(key) {
        Some(serde_json::Value::String(s)) => s,
        _ => String::new(),
    };
    let (level, message) = (text("level"), text("msg"));
    log.remove("time");
    Event::Log { level, message, attrs: serde_json::Value::Object(log) }
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct Message {
    #[serde(rename = "type", default)]
    kind: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    result: Option<serde_json::Value>,
    #[serde(default)]
    error: Option<ErrorMessage>,
    #[serde(default)]
    progress: Option<ProgressMessage>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct ProgressMessage {
    #[serde(rename = "type", default)]
    kind: String,
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_default")]
    manifest: ProgressManifest,
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_default")]
    item: ProgressItem,
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_default")]
    finish: ProgressFinish,
}

impl ProgressMessage {
    fn event(self) -> Option<Event> {
        match self.kind.as_str() {
            "manifest" => Some(Event::ProgressStart(self.manifest)),
            "update" => Some(Event::ProgressItem(self.item)),
            "finish" => Some(Event::ProgressEnd(self.finish)),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct ErrorMessage {
    #[serde(rename = "type", default)]
    kind: String,
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_default")]
    name: String,
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_default")]
    message: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_default")]
    extra: Vec<serde_json::Value>,
    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_default")]
    raw_err: String,
}

impl ErrorMessage {
    fn into_error(self, command: String) -> Error {
        if self.kind == "standard" {
            return Error::Standard {
                command,
                name: self.name,
                message: self.message,
                extra: self.extra,
            };
        }
        Error::Internal {
            command,
            name: self.name,
            message: self.message,
            raw_err: self.raw_err,
        }
    }
}
